title: Welcome to my website
excerpt: A brief note to introduce myself and this website. It also doubles as a template for writing future posts.
excerpt_zh: 一篇介绍本站和我的短文，同时作为以后写文章时的模板。

title: Some Principles for Making a Good Product
excerpt: Some principles I follow when creating — put yourself in the user's shoes, approach as an outsider, care for every detail, improve step by step, and mind how the work presents itself.
excerpt_zh: 把创作时的几条心法记下来：把自己当作使用它的用户，以外部人员的视角来使用产品，关注每一个角落，逐步变好而不求一步到位，并留意作品面向谁、属于什么类型。
